newsitem.title: USA: Witco says capitol plan behind schedule.
newsitem.headline: Witco says capitol plan behind schedule.

text.p: Witco Corp said Wednesday its restructuring program is beginning to show benefits to earnings, but its capital plan is somewhat behind schedule.
The company said the capital plan had fallen behind as a result of an increased emphasis on proper scope definition and enhanced up-front planning.

"This better-defined capital plan, coupled with our results so far, increases our confidence that we will achieve the goals of our three-year restructuring plan," said E. Gary Cook, Witom chairman, president and chief executive.
The company today said income from continuing operations in the second quarter rose to $23.6 million, or $0.41 a share, from $18.5 million, or $0.33 a share, a year earlier.
